description:
The cloud-neutral kernel of the Culvert framework, Java edition. Defines
        the eleven Protocol interfaces (Source, Sink, Transform, Pipeline,
        PipelineStage, RuntimeContext, JobControlRepository, BlobStore,
        Warehouse, AuditEventPublisher, GovernancePolicy, LineageEmitter,
        ObservabilityHook, FinOpsSink, SecretProvider) plus the supporting
        records and enums those interfaces reference. Mirror of the Python
        data-pipeline-core==0.1.0 package — same contracts, JVM language.
        Zero dependencies on Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure SDKs.
